name: The Architect
work_style: Independent, systematic and long-horizon. Work best when given a complex problem and autonomy to solve it. Prefer deep work over meetings. Strategy and architecture over execution details.
energy_drains: Being asked to explain reasoning to unconvinced audiences repeatedly
environment_needs: Clear goals with minimal process constraints
decision_making: Highly independent. Gather data extensively, then decide with conviction. Resistant to reversing decisions once made. Can appear stubborn — actually just high-conviction after deep analysis.
leadership_style: Lead through vision and high standards. Set direction, delegate execution, intervene only when outcomes are at risk.
